blocks.backend: literature double Virasoro; ordinary sphere CCY c-recursion
blocks.order_unit: physical internal level / degree in q; stored degree in sqrt(q) is 2*order
blocks.stop_at_cap: retain result, flag unconverged; never certify by cap alone

extrapolation.target: assembled native coefficient tables at fixed physical momenta; exact b=1 prefactors
extrapolation.error_control: independent low-order b=1 Ward and Cauchy checks; not an automatic error bound

moduli.atlas: original/swapped bulk, zero disk and one lens; apply adjacent-order rule on actual integration points before production

crossing.tolerance_origin: preparation acceptance criterion; separate from the user's 2% block stopping rule
crossing.integration: internal P only; no moduli integration
crossing.components: all 64 mixed and 16 RRRR external physical components, including independent NS left/right superpartners
crossing.branch: principal slit lifts; t=exp(i*pi*tau/2); crossed 1-z keeps its opposite imaginary part; explicit clockwise exchange/Mobius phase
crossing.antiholomorphic: conjugate convention coefficients analytically; keep physical complex momenta fixed

metadata.tail_domain: [tail, infinity); largest node is NOT a cutoff
[tail, infinity); largest node is NOT a cutoff

reuse_policy: Exact native family, ordered external momenta, P and dP weight; all physical channel roles retained.

precision_repair.reason: double-precision cancellation in finite branching and CCY assembled coefficients
